reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 2 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Hornets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Hornets win 53 times in 100; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.
